summary: A virtual financial-risk case competition for enrolled undergraduate and graduate students, with industry feedback and a creative-thinking team award.
eligibility: Any enrolled undergraduate or graduate student worldwide; cross-university teams and university-email verification. No coursework prerequisites.
title: PRMIA Risk Management Challenge 2027

prize.description: Top two teams receive cash awards (amounts unspecified); scholarships and memberships are non-cash benefits.

notes: Fee US$200 per team early bird (about 5 January), US$300 after. Round 1 submission 22 February; case materials from 1 December.
